summary.zh-Hans: 昌德宫始建于 15 世纪，宫殿与园林顺应自然地形布局，建筑和周围景观相互融合。
summary.en: First built in the 15th century, Changdeokgung arranges its palace buildings and gardens around the natural terrain, integrating architecture with the landscape.

summary.zh-Hans: 清溪川流经首尔市区，水边设有步行空间，并有广通桥等桥梁跨过水面；河道修复工程于 2005 年完成。
summary.en: Cheonggyecheon runs through Seoul with paths beside the water and crossings including Gwangtong Bridge. Its restoration project was completed in 2005.

summary.zh-Hans: 辣炒年糕用条状年糕配辣椒酱和蔬菜等烹制。首尔新堂洞有多家专营年糕的餐馆。
summary.en: Tteokbokki cooks rice-cake sticks with red chili paste, vegetables and other additions. Seoul’s Sindang-dong neighborhood has a cluster of restaurants specializing in the dish.

summary.zh-Hans: 绿豆煎饼以磨碎的绿豆为主要原料，在油锅中煎制。首尔广藏市场有售卖这种煎饼的店铺。
summary.en: Bindaetteok is a pan-fried pancake based on ground mung beans. Shops in Seoul’s Gwangjang Market serve it.
